name: Remote-controlled excavator
description: Excavator or similar hydraulic machine operated remotely through a retrofit kit.

CHK-ONSITE-ACTUATOR.question: Inspect actuator and hydraulic response on site

CHK-CLOCK-OFFSET.question: Establish the console–vehicle clock offset (sync logs or a shared event)
CHK-CLOCK-OFFSET.why: Without a bounded offset, absolute delay between console send and vehicle receipt is unknown, and any relative change rests on the offset staying stable.
